card.title: Maxima-minima — where the derivative signs the verdict

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Differentiation differentiates: product rule (first×d-second + second×d-first), quotient rule (low-d-high minus high-d-low over low²), chain rule (outside×inside, layered without limit). Parametric/implicit functions differentiate through their links; logarithmic differentiation tames products/powers/roots; Leibniz expands (uv)ⁿ. Geometry reads f′ as slope (tangent) with the normal perpendicular; f′ > 0 rises, f′ < 0 falls, f′ = 0 suspects extrema — confirmed by first-derivative sign change or second-derivative concavity.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: product: (uv)′ = u′v + uv′ · quotient: (u/v)′ = (u′v − uv′)/v² · chain: dy/dx = dy/du·du/dx  ·  tangent: y−y₀ = f′(x₀)(x−x₀) · normal slope −1/f′  ·  maxima: f′ = 0 with +→− (or f″ < 0) · minima: −→+ (or f″ > 0)  ·  d(sin x·cos x)/dx = cos2x (product-rule classic)

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Rules need differentiability at the point (corners/cusps/discontinuities break them). Chain rule needs each link differentiable. Second-derivative test needs f″ ≠ 0 at the stationary point (f″ = 0 inconclusive — higher derivatives or first test decide). Parametric differentiation needs dt/dx invertible (dx/dt ≠ 0).

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: y = sin x·cos x = ½sin2x → y′ = cos2x (product rule verified by identity). Logarithmic differentiation for y = x^x or huge products (ln both sides, differentiate implicitly). Tangent parallel to x-axis ⟺ f′ = 0. Optimisation: fence/area/volume word problems reduce to single-variable maxima.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: d/dx(sin x·cos x): product rule → cos x·cos x + sin x·(−sin x) = cos²x − sin²x = cos2x. Maxima drill: f′ = 0 gives suspects; sign chart +→− crowns maxima, −→+ minima, no-change saddles — first test never lies where the second test shrugs.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Differentiation describes smooth behaviour — Weierstrass monsters (continuous, nowhere differentiable) escape entirely. Leibniz's (uv)ⁿ needs n derivatives to exist. Optimisation on closed intervals must check ENDPOINTS (interior critical points miss boundary maxima).

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Product rule from the limit definition: Δ(uv)/Δx regroups to u·Δv/Δx + v·Δu/Δx → u′v + uv′ as Δx → 0 (continuity kills the cross term). Chain rule by Leibniz differentials (dy/dx = dy/du·du/dx, justified via limits). Tangent from secant limit; maxima tests from monotonicity flipping across stationary points.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Layered function? Chain first, ask questions later. Product vs quotient: plus vs minus-over-square. y = f(g(x)) forms: differentiate outside, keep inside, multiply by inside's derivative. Optimisation: single variable → f′ = 0 → sign chart → endpoints.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB-style: product/quotient/chain rule applications; parametric + implicit differentiation; logarithmic differentiation of powers; tangent/normal equations; maxima-minima word problems with both tests.
